answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments mainly on NLP setting... Benchmarks. We consider two types of benchmarks. One is from the widely used Open-LLM LeaderBoard, which contains ARC-Challenge(25shot) , MMLU(5-shot) , TruthfulQA(0-shot) , WinoGrande(5-shot) , and GSM8K(5-shot) . The other is LM-based evaluation, including TL;DR .
